excursionContents.titleGroup: HANOI - NINH BINH - DAY TRIP TO HOA LU- TAM COC (PRIVATE TOUR)
excursionContents.excursionContent:
8h00: Our tour guide will pick you up from your hotel. We take you to Ninh Binh province which is far from Hanoi city about 120 km.

9h15: Have a short break for 20 minutes to relax.

10h30: The first destination in this trip is visit Hoa Lu ancient capital. This is the first capital of Vietnam. Come to visit Hoa Lu, you will learn about why the capital was moved to Hanoi nowadays. You are impressed on an outstanding architecture when entering temples of King Dinh and King Le, the first and second emperors of ancient Vietnam, built in the 17 century. Try to feel ancient atmospheres in Hoa Lu ancient capital.

12h30: Have lunch by your own in the restaurant with a lot of local foods goat meat, fried rice… Vegetarian food is always available in the lunch.

13h30 – 14h00: Visit Tam Coc by 1,5 hour bamboo boat. During the boat trip, you will be surprised by the charming beauty here with paddy field, river, water, cloud, sky and stunning cave system. All make a masterpiece which Vietnamese people called “ Halong Bay on land “

16h00: Come back to our car to return to Hanoi.

18h30 – 19h00: Arrive to Hanoi and get dropped off at the Hotel. The trip end!

Note: The Tourguide will arrange the itinerary depending on the weather conditions.

excursionContents.titleGroup: PHU QUOC - SUNSET TOWN - KISS BRIDGE (PRIVATE TOUR)
excursionContents.excursionContent:
In the afternoon, set out on your own to explore the picturesque Sunset Town, located at the southern tip of the island. Inspired by Mediterranean coastal towns, this area is known for its romantic European-style architecture, seaside promenades, and colorful buildings.

Take a leisurely walk, enjoy ocean views, and discover scenic photo spots throughout the area.

As the sun begins to set, head to the iconic Kiss Bridge, a stunning architectural landmark where two curved structures nearly meet in the middle, symbolizing eternal love. It’s the perfect spot to take in the golden sunset over the sea and capture memorable photos.

contents.titleProductName: PHU QUOC - SUNSET TOWN - KISS BRIDGE (PRIVATE TOUR)
contents.content:
In the afternoon, set out on your own to explore the picturesque Sunset Town, located at the southern tip of the island. Inspired by Mediterranean coastal towns, this area is known for its romantic European-style architecture, seaside promenades, and colorful buildings.

Take a leisurely walk, enjoy ocean views, and discover scenic photo spots throughout the area.

As the sun begins to set, head to the iconic Kiss Bridge, a stunning architectural landmark where two curved structures nearly meet in the middle, symbolizing eternal love. It’s the perfect spot to take in the golden sunset over the sea and capture memorable photos.

excursionContents.excursionContent:
7h00-8h00AM : You will be picked up at your hotel/resort by bus (within Duong Dong Area).Vist and shopping pearl, the largest showroom center in Phu Quoc 

9:00 Arrive An Thới Harbor. You will get in the boat and start to explore four of the most scenic island in Phu Quoc.Arrive NAMASTE islet, you change swimming suit and start to experiences seawalking activities here (personal charge). With an oxygen helmet, you can walk in the seabed of 6m deep to sea different kind of corals, fish….

Fingernail Island (Mong Tay Island) is considered as a relaxing heaven with some awesome beaches, a very limpid sea water and smooth waves. 

Gam Ghi Island(Dam Ngang) will let you admire a range number of colorful coral. You will be participated in Snorkling for unleash tough and sightsee it’s beauty.

May Rut Trong Island or May Rut Ngoai Island : It have the longest beach in the islands .On the shore along the beach, there are shady coconut trees, adding to the pristine beauty of this land. The rows full of coconuts in the middle of the range, not too high, along with the inclined bodies on the beach, are like waving to invite you to pick.

Cano arrives Thom Island Port. Enjoy -  buffet lunch at Hon Thom

The tourguide will take you into Aquatopia Water Park-The largest Water Theme Park in Southeast Asia with more than 20 thrilling games.

Back on the Cable car in 25min- enjoy the sunset-amazing seaview and beautiful island from above.

Check-in Mediterranean Town Phu Quoc- Sunset City : As an emerging check-in place in Phu Quoc, visitors will surely be mesmerized and surprised by the ancient and luxurious beauty. Those are colorful buildings, architecture inspired by the Amalfi land in western Italy. And also the blue sea - white sand - golden sunshine stretching the island. All have created a unique attractive beauty for this town located in the south of Phu Quoc island. ( Free of charge )

The bus will pick you up at An Thoi Station.

18h00: Return to your hotel/Resort.
